core_meaning.primary_meaning: Galib is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Overcomer, victor, dominant”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Galib corresponds to the Arabic form غالِب (Arabic root غ ل ب (gh-l-b); غالِب (Ghālib)). Its core sense is powerful, victorious. Galib/ghalib is Arabic غالِب (Ghālib) 'overcomer, victor, dominant', the active participle of the root غ ل ب (gh-l-b) 'to overcome'. The source gloss 'powerful, victorious' is defensible. It is also a divine name in Islamic tradition.

persian.name: غالب
